If it were referring to artificial sweeteners or things to that nature then maybe it would help to be able to scan the ingredients as well as the nutrition label and point out what ingredients lead to the moderate or not recommended labels that is being given. Then for users like me who are still learning can have a better idea of things to watch out for when trying to pick healthier foods.

reviews.title: Great App for Glp Tracking
reviews.text: I wanted an app that would help support my needs with my Glp. Easy to use. But two things would make this better. When scanning the barcode on foods double check the values, some have been way off and I have had to re enter manually. The second would be support if you are taking supplements. My doctor recommended adding creatine to prevent muscle loss and I add it to my smoothie but the label is not supported. Otherwise it’s a great app. Glad I paid the premium and hope a future update will correct and add these features.

reviews.title: Close to be the best

reviews.title: Food Entry Section Needs Work
reviews.text:
I really like how this app lets you track water, shots, food, weight, etc. 
However, the food entry area is very limited and that’s been pretty disappointing for an app that’s paid for. That’s the main reason I paid for it. Search options are very limited. No restaurant food options, searchable food/entrees are very limited, you can’t pre-enter for the next day (for meal planning- entering as I prepare meals for the next day would be great), the option to change from “serving” to cup, Tbsp, oz, calories, etc would be great. Weight Watchers app was so much better in these areas but I’m not a member anymore so I can’t access it. 

Basically, the food entry section needs a lot of work for it to be worth paying for. I do regret buying the year plan.

reviews.title: Finally an app that actually made for GLP-1 and understand what I need!
reviews.text: I wish I had Glowise from day one. There's just so much to keep track of and before this I was jumping between different apps for different things. Glowise had made this SO much easier. I can put in my shots, protein, water, side effects, and see my weight trend all in one place without making this feel like a full time job. I'm so busy with my work and family and I really appreciate that Glowise also reminds me to take care of myself when I need it. It made me feel more organized and less overwhelmed. I've already recommended it to my GLP friends and will definitely keep using it!

reviews.title: Doesn’t adequately support
reviews.text:
Sadly, they didn’t offer a free seven day trial so I could test it. If so, I would’ve never purchased this app. It doesn’t let you track more than one GLP one symptom, it doesn’t offer serving sizes, it doesn’t have a nice library of commonly eaten foods, and the voice recording feature doesn’t work.

Please don’t get scammed like I did by purchasing this app on a “discount”. Even if it was free, it would be horrible.

reviews.title: Not all inclusive for Oral GLP-1
reviews.text: Software should be updated to include the new oral Wegovy medication.

reviews.title: Lacking Complexity
reviews.text: It mentions tracking your symptoms after shots but will not allow you to choose more than 1. You cannot find recipes without scrolling through five at a time. The water tracker amount button lags significantly and will not allow more than 10 oz of water at a time. It does not let you customize calories based on goals. You can add meals two ways but will guess based on time of day unless you note otherwise (breakfast lunch dinner snack). Which feels pointless if you can’t tell me when I should be eating the meals and why it would affect my GLP-1. It’s very simple and overtime I fear will not be “tracking” information so I can see patterns. There are other trackers out there better at assisting in real calorie counting, hydration and effects my GLP-1 is having.

reviews.title: Needs a TON of work.
reviews.text: I wish I wouldn’t have fallen for the lower price deal. I didn’t realize I was going to lose the free trial, now I’m stuck with a year subscription. There are absolutely no reaturaunts that you can search and add pre saved food from. I can’t even find my protein yogurt in this thing. I don’t have the time or patients to enter ever meal fact in for you. For the price I paid it should already be there. My calories are also WAY too low for the accelerated mode, I’ve gone over my calories every day and yet I’ve already hit my “3lbs” weekly weight loss in less than half the week. Seems like a pretty unhealthy app to follow.

reviews.title: Hard to believe goals
reviews.text: Unrealistic goals, set the first time I installed the app. At 242 pounds. There is no way I should be eating 239 carbs a day. Or 172 g of protein, with no way to adjust.

reviews.title: Needs Work
reviews.text:
Starting my GLP-1 journey, I was excited about using this app to guide my progress/journey. However, when getting to the section to add my weight. I was shocked to see that the highest weight that could be selected was 330 lbs. 

For someone starting this at a heavier weight, seeing that could be very discouraging especially for someone that is taking the steps to get healthier. 

I went ahead, deleted the app and found a different one to use that didn’t limit the starting weight entry.
